name: Heather Morrison
caption: A woman at the centre of the Tommy Kain and Tom Collins casket feud at EWWF Redemption in June 2002, whom Collins flaunts on a shirt and shuts into the casket with Kain.
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (msg_id VxieYMdreQUJ, 5 June 2002), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/redemption-parts-7-10-2002-06-05.html. Collins's ring shirt reads 'I love you Heather' with a photograph on the back; the commentary cries 'justice for Heather Morrison' and 'for Grant Morrison', whom Kain is said to have killed with a springboard bulldog. After Collins wins, she runs to the ring, is slammed into a guardrail and shut in the casket. The EWWF is the held wing named by the roleplay.
